source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 735 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-735.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 735 was established by Ordinance No. 26241, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 25, 2006. (Ord. 26241)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-735.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 735 is established on property located on the north side of Forest Lane, west of Abrams Road. The size of PD 735 is approximately 17.19 acres. (Ord. 26241)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-735.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. 26241)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-735.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 735A) and elevations (Exhibit 735B). In the event of a conflict between the development plan and elevations and Section 51A-4.605, the development plan and elevations control. In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 26241)

sections.title: Main Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-735.105. MAIN USES.

(a) The only main uses permitted in the area shown as Lot 1 on the development plan are:

-- General merchandise or food store 100,000 square feet or more. -- Nursery, garden shop, or plant sales. -- Local utilities.

(b) The only main uses permitted in the area shown as Lot 2 on the development plan are:

-- Restaurant without drive-in or drive-through service. -- Restaurant with drive-in or drive-through service. -- Local utilities. (Ord. 26241)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-735.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) For a general merchandise or food store 100,000 square feet or more use, in addition to accessory uses customarily permitted with this main use, the following accessory uses are specifically allowed within the building housing this main use:

-- Financial institution without drive-in window. -- Office. -- Personal service uses. -- Restaurant without drive-in or drive-through service. (Ord. 26241)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-735.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the MU-3 Mixed Use District apply in this district.

(b) Floor area. For a general merchandise or food store 100,000 square feet or more use, maximum floor area (excluding floor area for nursery, garden shop, or plant sales) is 205,000 square feet. (Ord. 26241)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-735.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) For a general merchandise or food store 100,000 square feet or more use, a minimum of one space per 225 square feet of floor area must be provided in the locations shown on the development plan. For a nursery, garden shop, or plant sales in the location shown on the development plan, a minimum of one space per 500 square feet of covered area, and a minimum of one space per 2,000 square feet of uncovered area, must be provided in the locations shown on the development plan.

(c) Section 51A-4.301(a)(6) which provides that parking spaces located on a public street or alley may not be included in the calculation of off-street parking requirements, does not apply to the right- of-way in the shaded area shown as “Existing Right-of-Way” on the development plan.

(d) For the area shown as Lot 2 on the development plan, a minimum of one space per 112 square feet of floor area must be provided in the locations shown on the development plan. (Ord. 26241)

sections.title: Ingress And Egress
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-735.109. INGRESS AND EGRESS.

(a) For a general merchandise or food store 100,000 square feet or more use, ingress to and egress from the Property must be provided from:

(1) the LBJ Freeway Service Road and Forest Lane in the locations shown on the development plan; and

(2) Abrams Road, with the location and design of the ingress from and egress to Abrams Road to be approved by the director of public works and transportation. Prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for a general merchandise or food store 100,000 square feet or more use, the applicant for the certificate of occupancy must provide proof to the building official of the applicant’s legal right to ingress from and egress to Abrams Road.

(b) Ingress to and egress from the Property by 18-wheel delivery vehicles is limited to the driveway from the LBJ Freeway Service Road. (Ord. 26241)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-735.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 26241)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-735.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 735C) as a minimum (i.e. additional landscaping is permitted).

(b) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 26241)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-735.112. SIGNS.

(a) For the area shown as Lot 1 on the development plan, signs are permitted as shown on the elevations and in the locations and sizes shown on the development plan.

(b) For the area shown as Lot 2 on the development plan, signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 26241)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-735.113. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) For a general merchandise or food store 100,000 square feet or more use, the provisions of Section 51A-4.605(a)(9)(H) are modified to read as follows:

(1) External speakers are prohibited, except for the intercom used to communicate with drive-through pharmacy customers.

(2) An external lighting plan demonstrating compliance with all city ordinances must be submitted to and approved by the building official prior to the issuance of a building permit for new construction, a building permit to expand to 100,000 square feet or more use, or a certificate of occupancy.

(b) For a general merchandise or food store 100,000 square feet or more use, material, color, and texture changes to the primary façade walls and secondary façade walls must be provided as shown on the elevations.

(c) For a general merchandise or food store 100,000 square feet or more use, one or more security officers from a licensed security services contractor or off-duty law enforcement personnel must be provided. The uniformed security officers must monitor the parking area during the hours of operation.

(d) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(e) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 26241)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-735.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, in this district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 26241)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-735.115. ZONING MAP.

PD 735 is located on Zoning Map No. D-9. (Ord. 26241)
